manifest:
{
  "schema": 1,
  "id": "lumen.example.word-stats",
  "name": "Word stats",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Words, characters, reading time and the most frequent words of the open note — Hebrew and English — in a side panel.",
  "author": "Lumen",
  "license": "MIT",
  "main": "main.js",
  "capabilities": [
    { "id": "document:read", "reason": "To count the words of the open note" },
    { "id": "commands", "reason": "Adds the “Word stats” command" },
    { "id": "panel", "reason": "Shows the numbers in a side panel" },
    { "id": "settings", "reason": "Remembers your reading speed" }
  ]
}
